name: University Plaza
summary: University Plaza is a community shopping center in Amherst, NY, managed by Phillips Edison & Company and strategically located near the University at Buffalo. The center serves as a convenient retail hub for students, faculty, and local residents with a strong 4.2-star rating from over 1,000 reviews.
demographics: University Plaza serves a diverse demographic anchored by the nearby University at Buffalo community, attracting college students, faculty, and young professionals seeking convenient shopping and dining options. The trade area encompasses middle to upper-middle income households in the Amherst and Eggertsville neighborhoods, with a strong presence of educated consumers aged 18-45. The center draws families and university-affiliated visitors who value accessibility and a practical mix of everyday retail and service offerings in the Buffalo metropolitan area.
description: University Plaza is a well-established community shopping center located at 3500 Main Street in Amherst, New York, strategically positioned along Main Road in the vibrant Eggertsville area. Owned and managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a nationally recognized leader in grocery-anchored shopping center ownership and management, this property serves as a convenient retail destination for the surrounding Buffalo metropolitan community. The center benefits from its proximity to the University at Buffalo, drawing a steady flow of students, faculty, and local residents seeking everyday shopping and services. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, University Plaza provides accessible retail options throughout the week. The property has earned a solid 4.2-star rating from over 1,000 Google reviews, reflecting its role as a trusted neighborhood shopping destination that combines convenience with quality tenant offerings.
